caption: The drawing depicts a square-shaped quilt pattern composed of geometric shapes and various colors. The outermost part of the central square is bordered by four large white rectangular segments, one on each side, with a red square at each corner. Inside this white border, the main pattern consists of four large orange triangles pointing toward the center, each separated by smaller right-angled triangles and quadrilaterals featuring a combination of patterned and solid sections; these patterns include red, brown, and white colors with decorative elements such as dots, lines, and geometric motifs. In the very center of the square, there is a smaller diamond-shaped section filled with a white fabric that has a simple grid of black dots. The composition is entirely symmetrical and uses a palette dominated by red, white, orange, and brown, with patterned fabrics interspersed among mostly solid-colored shapes. The drawing is on an off-white, slightly textured background.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
